captureMode: bounded repeated screenshots; no rolling-video capability used

claims.claim: The title communicates the premise and exposes usable solo and co-op starts.
claims.action: Open route, then click One Warden.
claims.observed: Centered warm-dusk title card, premise, currency rules, controller hint, and two distinct mode buttons were fully visible; One Warden transitioned to the battlefield.

claims.claim: The active battlefield visually distinguishes the two gate halves, inner ward, resources, and threats.
claims.action: Observe the opening wave and settled active state.
claims.observed: Enemies marched in two straight outside formations; north/south tower cards, shared resource counters, four plots, inner paths, hearth integrity, and the controllable warden remained readable. No browser warnings or errors were recorded.

claims.claim: Building and upgrading give visible and numerical feedback.
claims.action: Click an empty plot, choose Forge, then upgrade Rowan Tower.
claims.observed: The four-choice building modal opened without clipping. Forge appeared on the chosen plot, metal fell by its cost, and +1.9/s appeared. The tower changed from DMG 1 to DMG 2, its next gold cost rose, and gold decreased.

claims.claim: A fallen side creates a readable breach and changes enemy behavior inside.
claims.action: Allow gate pressure to destroy both tower halves.
claims.observed: A red quick-rebuild banner showed side, countdown, and metal cost. Fallen towers rendered as rubble. Breached enemies visibly fanned onto separate inner paths and displayed ×2 markers while advancing toward the hearth.

claims.claim: Pause, outcome, replay routing, and local co-op setup recover visibly.
claims.action: Reach game over, return to mode select, start Two Wardens, pause, wait, and resume.
claims.observed: Game over showed time, night, defeats, breaches, special count, and score plus replay/mode actions. Co-op displayed two differently colored wardens and two status chips. Pause held the timer at 0:08 across an 800 ms observation, then resume advanced it to 0:09.

claims.claim: The compact shared-screen layout avoids viewport overflow.
claims.observed: Stage measured 880x495 within a 900x600 document; document scroll width/height stayed exactly 900x600. Both tower cards, wardens, hearth, plots, resources, and bottom dock remained visible.

claims.claim: A physical Xbox controller feels correct and reconnects cleanly.
claims.action: No physical controller was exposed to the browser session.
claims.observed: The portable control profile and semantic core mapping passed automated checks, but hardware feel, right-stick release timing, and unplug/replug recovery cannot be inferred from those checks.
